exposure: absorbable sutures for rectus diastasis repair
cohort: 71 female patients who underwent abdominoplasty with rectus diastasis repair using absorbable sutures and had at least 6 months of follow-up
finding: Abdominal wall plication using long-lasting absorbable sutures for rectus diastasis repair during abdominoplasty resulted in no diastasis recurrence and a low complication profile.
